x: Finlay, the English 120 yards hurdles champion, represented, quite rightly, Surrey Athletic Club. A WEEK later, at the British Games, in a programme of inter-club events, he competed for Milocarians A.C. in the short hurdles event.
Jones represented us in the Kinnaird Trophy hurdles, but were drawn in heats with Finlay and Pilbrow respectively, and so were unable to qualify for the final.

Now at the top of his form, the Surrey A.C. man struck gold again and was one of only four A.A.A. champions to repeat their victories at the ‘Games’, also held on the White City cinders, the others being Rampling (440 yds), Lovelock (1 mile) and Finlay (120 yds hurdles).
